messages:
Alex: Heads up — our main CI on feature/response-gen is red after the secrets rotation. Job failing with permission denied on KMS decrypt step. Anyone else seeing this? (workflow #482)
Maria: :eyes: can you paste the log snippet? probably GH App token scope lost during rotation
Alex: here you go:
```
Run terraform apply
Error: KMS Decrypt failed: access denied
status=403, operation=kms.decrypt, key=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-key
```
Jordan: looks like the action runner can't read the secret. Did we rotate the service account or the GitHub App config yesterday?
Alex: we rotated the vault->gha binding at 09:12 UTC — I updated the vault role -> github app mapping but maybe missed the repo install scope.
Tess: quick check — can someone try triggering a manual rerun of the workflow? if it's transient a rerun will tell us if it's expired token vs permission
Infra Oncall: I can run a scoped rerun and tail logs, starting now
ci-bot: Re-run requested by Infra Oncall — workflow #482 attempt 2
Infra Oncall: reran, same failure. copying the step with env
```
GITHUB_TOKEN=***
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/runtime/actions/runs/482/jobs
=> 401 Unauthorized
```
Maria: 401 on api — that GITHUB_TOKEN probably has reduced scopes. Check the GitHub App's permissions: Actions: write? Secrets: read? need to ensure it can access actions/secrets via the app
Jordan: I can re-install the GitHub App to this repo to refresh the token. If Infra Oncall can hold off merges for 10m I'll do it.
Alex: can we also verify that KMS IAM binding still includes gha-sa@project. I saw a recent iam binding edit in gcloud audit logs.
Infra Oncall: confirmed the KMS binding still has the service account. Suspect it's the GitHub App token lacking "secrets" permission to retrieve from our vault provider.
Tess: Proposed quick mitigation: create a temporary deploy token with limited repo scope and set it as a repo secret to unblock CI. TTL 1h.
Alex: +1. Jordan — can you do the app reinstall? I'll create the temp secret and TTL 1h.
Jordan: on it, reinstalling now, will ping when done.
ci-bot: GitHub App reinstalled by Jordan at 09:47 UTC
Infra Oncall: Confirmed workflow retried with temp secret — now KMS decrypt step passed. All green on run #482 attempt 3
Alex: thanks all. Follow-up: I'll open a short postmortem doc and a checklist so rotation includes App reinstall and validate scopes. tagging @product for rollback docs
Tess: added action item in #eng-infra-playbooks: add "verify gha app scopes" to secret rotation playbook :white_check_mark:
Alex: closing thread as resolved, will open the doc in about 30m
